# Temple Scroll Column 63 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 63 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**63:1** You must investigate carefully, making thorough inquiry. If the report is confirmed as true — if this outrage has really been committed among you —

**63:2** you must slaughter every inhabitant of that city with the sword. You must completely destroy the city, everything in it, and all its livestock.

**63:3** Pile all the plunder in the town square and burn the entire city and all its goods as a sacrifice to me.

**63:4** The city must remain a permanent ruin, never to be rebuilt. You must keep none of the condemned goods for yourselves,

**63:5** so that I may relent from my fierce anger and show you mercy, having compassion on you and increasing your numbers, just as I promised your ancestors,

**63:6** because you listened to me and kept all the commands I am giving you today, doing what is right in my eyes.

**63:7** Never offer me an ox or sheep that is defective in any way — that is something I detest.

**63:8** Do not eat anything I have declared unfit. Here are the animals you may eat: cattle, sheep, and goats,

**63:9** deer, gazelles, roebuck, wild goats, ibex, antelopes, and mountain sheep.

**63:10** You may eat any animal that has a completely split hoof and also chews its cud.

**63:11** Every year you must set aside a tenth of everything your fields produce.

**63:12** You are to eat this tithe in my presence — your grain, new wine, and olive oil — at the place I will choose as a dwelling for my name,

**63:13** along with the firstborn of your herds and flocks, so that you will learn to honor me throughout your lives.

**63:14** But if the place I choose to put my name is too far away and the journey is too long for you to carry the tithe,

**63:15** and if I have blessed you abundantly, then sell the tithe for silver, take the money, and travel to the place I will choose.

**63:16** Spend the money on anything you want — cattle, sheep, wine, beer, whatever appeals to you — and feast there in my presence, celebrating with your whole family.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 63 moves from the total destruction of the apostate city to practical laws about offerings, diet, and tithing. The burning of the city "as a sacrifice to me" makes explicit what the Hebrew implies — the חרם is a sacred act. "Beer" for שכר captures what "strong drink" actually was. The tithing provisions show God's practical care — if the distance is too far, sell and rebuy at the destination.*
